title: SvgUse
responsibility: Renders the native use element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgUse.attributes
inputs.description: Native use attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgUse.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native use element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgUse
outputs.description: The actual native use element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
